Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: eyes of light
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: The Nightwatcher's gift is subtle - a change in the color of {PAWN_nameDef}'s eyes. In the morning light, they shine. Where once dark irises marked {PAWN_nameDef} as common, now pale eyes speak of station. The caste system bends to Cultivation's will. Lighteyes.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: nimble hands
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s fingers move with a certainty that wasn't there before. Tools fit {PAWN_possessive} grip like old friends. Materials bend where {PAWN_pronoun} wants them to, as if they were always meant to.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: sharpened mind
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: {PAWN_nameDef} thinks faster now. Problems that used to take hours resolve in moments, as if {PAWN_pronoun} already knew the answers and simply had to remember them.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: stormlight touched
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: Something of Cultivation lingers in {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} can hold more Stormlight than {PAWN_possessive} body should allow, and {PAWN_possessive} hands move with a precision that feels borrowed from someone far more practiced.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: touched by cultivation
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: The Nightwatcher changed something in {PAWN_nameDef}. Not {PAWN_possessive} mind, not {PAWN_possessive} body. Something deeper. Compassion comes easily now, even when it costs {PAWN_nameDef} something to give it.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: windswept spirit
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: A quiet has settled over {PAWN_nameDef}. The anxieties that once circled {PAWN_possessive} thoughts have grown distant. They are not gone. They are simply harder to reach.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: hunter's gift
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s instincts are sharper now. The hesitation before a fight is gone, replaced by something fluid and certain. {PAWN_pronoun} reacts before {PAWN_pronoun} thinks, and the reactions are always right.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: always warm
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: It was a strange thing to ask for. The Nightwatcher seemed amused. But now {PAWN_nameDef} is never cold. Wind passes through {PAWN_nameDef} without bite, and {PAWN_pronoun} has not shivered since that night in the valley.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: mended body
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: The Nightwatcher reached into {PAWN_nameDef} and found the old wounds, the places where the body had given up on healing. She smoothed them out. What was broken is mended now. Not perfect, but whole.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: cultivated intellect
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: Cultivation planted something in {PAWN_nameDef}'s mind. A seed. {PAWN_pronoun} learns faster than anyone should, picking up skills the way a sponge takes water. Knowledge sticks where it used to slide away.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: stormlight affinity
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: The Nightwatcher reshaped {PAWN_nameDef}'s Spiritweb, aligning it with the rhythm of the storms. {PAWN_pronoun} can hold far more Stormlight now, and {PAWN_possessive} Connection to Surgebinding has deepened in ways that are difficult to explain.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: voice of cultivation
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: {PAWN_nameDef} speaks and people listen. Not because {PAWN_possessive} voice is louder, but because the words land exactly where they need to. Deals close. Arguments settle. People trust {PAWN_nameDef} without quite knowing why.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: forgotten sorrow
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: The grief is still there. {PAWN_nameDef} knows this. But the Nightwatcher took it and put it somewhere {PAWN_pronoun} cannot reach. {PAWN_pronoun} remembers that {PAWN_pronoun} should feel sorrow, but the feeling itself is gone. It is a mercy. It is also, somehow, a loss.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: metalborn spark - misting
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: The Nightwatcher reaches into {PAWN_nameDef}'s Spiritweb and twists something fundamental. A new Connection forms - to Preservation, to a metal, to something that was never meant to be {PAWN_possessive}. {PAWN_pronoun} can feel it now: a single metal, calling to be burned.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: metalborn spark - ferring
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: The Nightwatcher reshaped {PAWN_nameDef}'s soul. Where there was nothing, now there is a reservoir - a place to store, a place to draw from. One metal answers {PAWN_possessive} call, and {PAWN_possessive} metalminds will remember what {PAWN_pronoun} gives them.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: mistborn
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: This was no small thing to ask. The Nightwatcher hesitated - not from reluctance, but from the sheer weight of what {PAWN_nameDef} demanded. Then she reached into {PAWN_possessive} Spiritweb and cracked it wide open. Every metal sings now. Iron and steel, tin and pewter, all of them. {PAWN_nameDef} burns with Preservation's full gift. The mists will recognize {PAWN_nameDef}.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: full feruchemist
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: Cultivation understands growth, and what she gave {PAWN_nameDef} is the ultimate expression of it. Every metal now holds a piece of {PAWN_nameDef} - speed, strength, memory, warmth, youth. {PAWN_pronoun} can pour {PAWN_possessive} attributes into metal and draw them back tenfold. The Terris would weep to see it given so freely.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: lifelight
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: Cultivation rewrote something fundamental in {PAWN_nameDef}. Food converts directly into Investiture now, light pooling beneath {PAWN_possessive} skin like warmth from a fire. {PAWN_possessive} body heals faster, fights harder, sustains itself with an efficiency that shouldn't be possible. This is the rarest of Cultivation's gifts.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: awakened mind
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: The Nightwatcher cracked {PAWN_nameDef}'s Spiritweb wide open. Investiture floods in like water through broken stone. {PAWN_possessive} Connection to Cultivation runs deep now, and {PAWN_possessive} capacity for Stormlight has expanded beyond anything natural. The rhythms of Roshar hum through {PAWN_possessive} bones. Spren will notice.

Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.label: slowed clock
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.NightwatcherBo.description: Time stopped for {PAWN_nameDef}. Not dramatically, not with any fanfare. {PAWN_possessive} body simply holds where it is now, no longer aging, no longer declining. {PAWN_pronoun} needs less rest. Disease struggles to take hold. {PAWN_pronoun} will not grow old. Cultivation is patient, and this is her most patient gift.
